Clare Schuchardt-Vogt <cschucha@asu.edu>:
Hello!I am having trouble getting a participant onboarded. She put in her email and signed up in the ethica app. I ensured it was the right app, and that the email matched the one we had. When it asked her for the study code, I gave it to her (after I sent the invite email), and it said she was not invited. I double-checked the email and the code - same thing again. I even had her go into the app through the invite email, and got the same result. I had her close out the app and go back in…no better. I did double check in writing that the emails were the same. The email address and username were daulphin@cox.net. The study ID is 3687 and the Participant ID assigned through the invite was 103040. Thanks! Clare Schuchardt Clare Schuchardt-Vogt MPH, RN, CPH PhD Student, Arizona State University Research Assistant, College of Nursing and Healthcare Innovation Cschucha@asu.edu 314-825-5418------

Ahmad Jafari <support@avicennaresearch.com>:
Hello Clare, I hope this email finds you well. I apologize for the inconvenience caused during the onboarding process of the participant. I have shared this issue with our technical team for further investigation. In the meantime, please ask the participant to follow these steps to join the study: Open the Avicenna Research app. Navigate to Settings -> Join Study -> Registration Code. Enter the study ID 3687 in the given field and tap on the JOIN STUDY button. If the participant continues to face issues, please let me know and I'll be happy to assist further. Thank you for your understanding and cooperation. Best regards,Ahmad Feel free to make any additional adjustments as needed! Note: If you feel like your issue is not properly being addressed and want to escalate it, please click here: https://avicennaresearch.com/app/public/zammad/escalate/25323/1a79814092d0abe1 --Avicenna Research (formerly Ethica Data)4109 - 295 Adelaide St W, Toronto, ON M5V 0L4, Canada Email: support@avicennaresearch.com - Web: https://avicennaresearch.com-- On Tuesday, October 1, 2024 at 12:22:14 AM,
